name: nemotron-3.5-asr-de-telephony
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (config.json max_position_embeddings 5000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.6 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence openmdw-1.1, repo created 2026-07-07.

benchmarks.name: VoxPopuli DE telephony-style WER
benchmarks.config: Card 'Evaluation' table, row 'Base nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b' 14.81% vs 'This fine-tuned model' 12.42%, same 1,054-utterance held-out test split. German prompt conditioning, lang-tag stripping on. In-domain: fine-tuned on 25 h VoxPopuli DE passed through a simulated G.711 A-law chain; the telephone condition is simulated, not real PSTN.
